name: tommoore-notes
description: The gallery's note wall API, on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply tommoore-notes --local && wrangler dev --port 8787 --var PER_DAY:100
scripts.seed: node seed.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute tommoore-notes --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql
